24788f09: ;
 .;DGJOPR routine to print Staff/Physician report of Incomplete Records
 .;for the specified Date range and Inpatient/Outpatient Status.
 .;Routine will also include the ability to select the particular
 .;Incomplete Record Status to be included in the report.
de081138: ;Set initial Report Starting Date to the 'INCOMPLETE' xref in File 393.2 and Report Direction to Forward/Ascending.
53bf6dd6: ;Set report direction to backward/descending.
7f4373f0: ;Set default sort to PATIENT if no response or entry begins with 'P' or 'p'.
62afe9a3: ;Interpret sort order response: E=EVENT DATE, D=DOCTOR, S=SERVICE.
b06b4a01: ;If '?' print Help to select sort order.
9916dd7f: ;If -1 returned from DGJHELP print Help and re-prompt for sort order.
65bb9a6f: ;Set default scope to Both Inpatients and Outpatients if no response or entry begins with 'B' or 'b'.
91e0fd39: ;Interpret scope response: I=Inpatients, O=Outpatients.
ae61a55d: ;If '?' print Help to select scope.
491b2a9f: ;If -1 returned from DGJHELP print Help and re-prompt for scope.
740fe3a7: ;Check for multi-facility ID and store in DGJTMUL.
3fe85c98: ;If report direction is backward call SEL to select record status.
a67e7a62: ;Set DGJTL to values for branching based on sort order selected.
643bdffb: ;Branch to DGJOPRT1 to begin printing report.
61aa06fb: ;Kill all variables used.
d372af0e: ;Print help text for valid sort order selections.
3e20c63e: ;Quit - no more help text.
9461fab5: ;Print help text for valid scope selections.
f342b6ce: ;Quit - no more help text.
87458b83: ;Setup sort order array for help.
289eeca9: ;Setup scope array for help.
0fbe8143: ;Prompt for Incomplete Record Status selection with defaults.
4916c017: ;Describes selections for Incomplete Record Status.
3080acf2: ;Start of multiple lines for Incomplete Record Status selections.
ce4072e2: ;End of multiple lines for selections, call Reader.
7b209196: ;If timed out or up-arrowed out, quit.
b7af1474: ;If 'A' selected, set DGJTSTAT to all status xrefs.
50c037fc: ;Initialize DGJTSTAT to null.
f1c94cc2: ;Call SET to set first status selection.
19d90c3d: ;Reset DIR(0) parameters for selecting additional statuses.
7dfdd690: ;Reset DIR('?') array for additional status selections.
a70ecc79: ;Reset DIR('A') prompt for additional status selections.
7c429fe9: ;Re-call Reader, if timed out or up-arrowed, quit.
93e771f7: ;If response not null, call SET to set additional status.
2867c688: ;Quit after selections completed.
e95fa30e: ;Set X to text of status selected based on Y response.
2ea52e16: ;Lookup xref of status text and set X to the xref value.
c6a82c8e: ;Append xref value to DGJTSTAT separated by '^'.
4799cfd2: ;Quit SET routine.
d0293c50: ;Dummy label to verify paramater passing on some systems.
